name: item-repair-hub
author: DaggerHashimoto
description: An in-game item editor for renewal and pre-renewal: give weapons and armor optional skills and attack autocasts, adjust class access and transfer rules, and change the gear you wear live with no restart (plain-English effects, a description check, stat presets). In renewal it also restores iRO item effects (refine tiers, autocasts, Base Level bonuses) for 33 items. Lasting edits use Save & Export, folder replacement, then Apply & restart.
